g.title: MAESTRO_HHM_Core
g.text: MAESTRO HHM-Core (proposed): seven HHM-Core clusters plus telemetry, energy, maintenance and MaaS modules

g.title: EXT_resource
g.text: open-domain datatype properties (drawn on the classes that use them): description : string, location : string, manufacturer : string, model : string, serialNumber : string, version : string

g.title: State
g.text: individuals: Alarm, Available, Busy, Degraded, Failed, Fault, Healthy, Reserved

g.title: EXT_skill
g.text: QUDT: unitRef holds a QUDT unit IRI (hook only)
open-domain datatype properties (drawn on the classes that use them): expression : string

g.title: InterfaceDescriptionLanguage
g.text: individuals (ext/opcua, ext/dtdl, ext/rest, ext/digital-twin): Asset Administration Shell submodel template, DTDL, OPC UA NodeSet, OpenAPI

g.title: ControlFlowType
g.text: individuals: Alternative, Loop, Optional, Parallel, Precedes

g.title: EXT_product
g.text: open-domain datatype properties (drawn on the classes that use them): quantity : decimal

g.title: DataFormat
g.text: individuals (ext/data-formats, ext/opcua): JSON, OPC UA Binary, Protocol Buffers, XML

g.title: Protocol
g.text: individuals (one ext/ module per protocol): DDS, EtherCAT, HTTP, MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA, PROFINET

g.title: EXT_invocation
g.text: JSON, XML, Protobuf data formats -> ext/data-formats.ttl
MQTT, DDS, Modbus, PROFINET, EtherCAT -> one ext/ module each

g.title: Action
g.text: individuals: Change a configuration, Invoke a skill or service, Read data, Write data

g.title: EXT_policy
g.text: SHACL shapes in shapes/ ; ODRL core profile -> ext/odrl.ttl ; XACML (hook only)

g.title: PerformanceLevel
g.text: individuals: PL a, PL b, PL c, PL d, PL e

g.title: Role
g.text: individuals: Customer role, Marketplace role, Provider role

g.title: ExecutionStatus
g.text: individuals: Aborted, Completed, Executing, Held, Idle

g.title: EXT_execution
g.text: open-domain datatype properties (drawn on the classes that use them): faultCause : string, faultCode : string, faultSeverity : string, timestamp : dateTime

g.title: EXT_telemetry
g.text: ExecutionStatus (core) is a subclass of State

g.title: EnergySource
g.text: individuals: Compressed air, Electrical grid, Solar, Wind

g.title: EXT_energy
g.text: Bare-number properties carry fixed units (kWh, W, g CO2-eq/kWh)

g.title: EXT_maintenance
g.text: Module also carries mtbfHours and remainingUsefulLifeHours
datatype properties on classes of other modules: Module.mtbfHours : number, Module.remainingUsefulLifeHours : number

g.title: ReturnToServiceOutcome
g.text: individuals: Cleared for service, Cleared with conditions, Not cleared

g.title: EXT_maas
g.text: open-domain datatype properties (drawn on the classes that use them): leadTimeDays : decimal
